documentedContract: - On macOS, `cua.getApp(...)` accepts an app's display name, full app path, or bundle identifier and launches the app in the background if needed. If display-name resolution fails, retry with the app's bundle identifier from `cua.listApps()`.
observedJsBoundary: create_tinysky_alt.getApp -> computer.get_app_state -> MacComputerUseClient.getAppState; no separate startApp call in these JS bodies
nativeImplementation: Independent Swift LaunchServices background launch in GetSkyshot. Original native bodies not recovered; native permission-error ordering not established.
acceptanceScope: Owned fixture cold launch/reuse and non-activation via installed and restored JS clients against reconstructed Swift. This is not original native binary differential acceptance.
